title: User Registration with Email Verification
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with a unique email, complete email verification, and complete onboarding to access the feed.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page
Input valid unique email and password
Submit registration form
Check that a verification email is sent
Verify email by clicking link in email
Confirm email verification is successful
Complete onboarding steps
User accesses the social feed page
Attempt registration with an already used email
Check error message about duplicate email

title: Login with Rate Limiting and Password Recovery
description: Test secure login functionality including valid and invalid credentials, rate limiting after multiple failed attempts, and password recovery flow.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid email and password
Submit login form
Verify user is logged in successfully and redirected
Log out
Attempt to login with invalid password repeatedly to trigger rate limiting
Check that further attempts are blocked with appropriate error
Navigate to password recovery page
Input registered email to send password recovery instructions
Verify that password recovery email is sent
Reset password using link in email
Verify new password works for login

title: Profile Editing and Smart Avatar Generation
description: Ensure users can edit personal and professional profile data with automatic avatar generation and badge system updates based on profile completeness.

steps.description: Login and navigate to profile edit page
Update personal and professional information fields
Save changes
Verify updated info is persisted and displayed
Check that smart avatar updates automatically based on changes
Trigger badge system evaluation (e.g., complete profile)
Verify badge status updates appropriately
Attempt to set invalid data and save
Verify validation errors are displayed and data is not saved

title: Real-time Social Feed Operations
description: Verify real-time feed operations including automatic welcome posts, posting reviews, likes, comments, shares, trending calculations, and @mentions.

steps.description: Login as new user and observe automatic welcome post
Check welcome post is displayed in feed
Create a manual post including a mention (@user)
Verify post appears with correct mention formatting
Like, comment and share a post
Confirm like count increments, comment appears, and share is successful
Post a professional review and check automatic post is created
Verify review post appears and correct notification is sent to professional
Validate trending system by interacting with multiple posts
Check trending posts section updates according to interactions

title: Floating Chat System with Real-time Messaging and Notifications
description: Test chat presence on all pages, real-time messaging with read status, notifications for new messages, and scheduling functionality.

steps.description: Login as two users in separate browsers/devices
Verify floating chat UI is present on multiple pages
Send message from user A to user B
Verify message is received in real-time by user B
Check read status updates after user B views the message
Verify that a notification is shown for new incoming messages
Schedule a chat message or meeting via scheduling system in chat
Confirm scheduled event is created and notifications are sent

title: ConfiPoints Economy System Validation
description: Ensure points are correctly earned, spent, displayed in dashboard, updated in rankings, and referral bonus transactions are processed.

steps.description: Perform activities that earn points up to daily cap
Verify points credit in user balance and transaction history
Attempt to earn points beyond daily cap
Confirm no further points are granted beyond cap
Spend points in ConfiPoints store
Verify points debited and item received
Transfer points to another user
Confirm points debited from sender and credited to receiver with transaction logs
Check points dashboard and global ranking update accordingly
Register a new user using referral code
Verify referral bonus points added to referrer

title: Advanced Search Filters and Proximity Search
description: Validate multi-filter search features including location, service type, price, rating filters, text queries, and geographical proximity ordering of results.

steps.description: Navigate to search page
Input multiple filter criteria (location, service, price range, rating)
Perform free text search including special characters
Verify search results meet all applied filters
Validate order of results by closest proximity when location filter is used
Clear filters and perform empty search
Verify default popular results or informative empty state

title: Review and Recommendation Posting with Automatic Feed Posts
description: Verify users can post professional reviews and recommendations, see automatic feed posts generated, check star rating application, and review history.

steps.description: Complete service interaction (simulate or use test account)
Post a review with star rating and written feedback
Verify review is saved and star rating is correctly stored
Check automatic post appears in user's feed
Verify professional receives notification of new review
Access review history page
Confirm all posted reviews are listed accurately

title: Notification System with Real-time Updates and Customization
description: Test sending and receiving real-time notifications with customizable sounds, push notifications, granular settings, and silent mode activation.

steps.description: Trigger various notifications (likes, comments, messages)
Verify notifications are received in real-time
Enable and test push notifications on device
Confirm push notifications arrive correctly
Change notification sound settings
Verify sounds play according to configuration when notification is received
Activate silent mode
Check that no sounds or push notifications interfere while silent mode is on
Use granular settings to disable specific notification types
Confirm disabled notifications do not appear

title: Progressive Web App (PWA) Features and Offline Support
description: Validate PWA installability, offline usage with smart caching, service worker functionality, and native push notification support.

steps.description: Access the application in supported browser
Verify prompt to install PWA appears and installation completes successfully
Navigate through app pages online to enable caching
Simulate offline mode by disconnecting network
Verify cached pages load and app functions offline gracefully according to requirements
Test service worker updates and cache refresh
Confirm new content is properly delivered and no errors occur
Send a push notification while app active or in background
Verify notification reception and correct display

title: Admin Dashboard Functionality and User Management
description: Test admin capabilities including user management, ban/unban users, report handling, viewing analytics and logs, and points management.

steps.description: Login as admin user
Navigate to user management section
Search for users by criteria
Verify search results are accurate and displayed
Ban a user and check ban is enforced
Confirm user access is revoked and visible in bans list
Access reports and investigate a selected report
Verify report details and investigation logging
View analytics and statistics dashboards
Confirm data is accurate and updated
Manage points for users (add/remove)
Verify points changes reflect correctly in user accounts and logs

title: LGPD Compliance: Data Portability and Account Deletion
description: Verify full compliance with LGPD requirements including privacy policy visibility, cookie consent, data export, and account deletion with data removal.

steps.description: Access privacy policy and terms of use pages
Verify policies are correctly displayed
Trigger cookie consent prompt and accept or reject
Confirm consent preferences are respected and saved
Request data export via user settings or LGPD API
Verify data export is accurate, complete, and delivered in reasonable time
Request account deletion
Confirm account and associated personal data are deleted according to LGPD
Attempt to retrieve data of deleted account
Verify data is no longer available and account cannot be accessed
